# Test photos

Real product photos that once caused problems, used by `tests/tests.js`.
They're kept out of the public repo (see `.gitignore`), so the tests that
use them are skipped on computers that don't have them.

- `pot-with-feet.webp`: an empty pot shot slightly from above, with feet and a
  notched base. Its pot center used to be detected ~150px too far left.
